info.subtitle: What the October 2026 study shows, and what it does not

rows.title: The audiogram beat diagnosis codes

rows.title: Four genes, not a verdict
rows.desc: EML6, SPTBN1, ARHGEF28 and EYA4 are linked, not decisive

rows.title: A risk score is a probability
rows.desc: The score's link to self-reported deafness was modest: odds ratio 1.09

rows.title: There is no genetic test to order
rows.desc: This is research. It is not a clinical test for patients

rows.title: Your own baseline still matters
rows.desc: A current audiogram is the data that guides care today
